title: Growing up in Donaldsonville: no bands, no dances for girls
summary: Donaldsonville was a small straight town where bands came from New Orleans and girls were not allowed to dance.

blocks.x: I was wondering about up at Donaldsonville, the very first music you can remember when

you were a girl. Do you remember any of the, did they have any parades or dance bands, what kind of bands in the country and all around there too? Well, we didn't have much of a band. The band used to come from New Orleans. Mostly the bands from here.
And they didn't give, that's a small town, Donaldsonville. Yes. And a girl couldn't go to a dance. Couldn't go to a dance.
No, not like a boy who runs all over town.

You had to have the meditation. You wasn't allowed to dance. So the girls didn't get around much. And they had no band there. Whenever they were going to have a band, they'd send to New Orleans and a band would come down. But they didn't have all of this gallivanting around and going on because it was very straight town, little town, beautiful town, beautiful. And they were nice people, nice people to know. And the streets was all, old flowers all over the streets and everything.
